Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Implement one release-convergence increment that stabilizes dense final-wave runtime cost and lifecycle cleanup while delivering truthful choice presentation and spatially coherent authored-cemetery traversal.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release-convergence dense-run performance contract remains failed. The candidate has dense profiling definitions, but sustained final-wave behavior still needs authoritative caps, staggered expensive work, and deterministic cleanup across death, despawn, reset, and retry. The same bounded task must also satisfy the required choice visual hierarchy and arena spatial integrity capabilities.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, hide, duplicate, reposition, or surgically alter the preserved AuthoredCemeteryPackage, Warden hierarchy, retained weapon resources, or retained audio recordings.
Do not disposition or implement deferred findings finding.automatic_attack_audio, finding.dense_profile_native_gap, or finding.arena_camera_occlusion.
Stop after candidate implementation and focused self-validation; host recapture, formal verdicts, and gap closure remain validation-owned.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different runtime-budget strategy based on authoritative live/spawn caps, deterministic pooling and reset, token-bucket scheduling, and lifecycle cancellation. Fold the mandatory choice and arena capabilities into the same concrete product task as release-safe presentation and spatial acceptance, without asset replacement or transform-tuning.

code: Run project parse/resource-load and existing unit or headless checks for wave progression, pooling, combat transactions, upgrade drafting, cemetery instantiation, and reset/retry.

Verify telemetry reports bounded active/pooled counts, frame-time/update-budget samples, and zero orphan nodes, timers, listeners, or stale references after death, despawn, victory, failure, reset, and retry.

Verify upgrade cards expose silhouette/icon-first hierarchy, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant deltas, filtered placeholders/unchanged rows, and deterministic keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
Verify cemetery scene and spatial contract preserve the intact authored package, outer datum, collision boundaries, navigation/spawn exclusion, and camera visibility configuration.
runtime: Host/Tester recaptures native 1920x1080 dense gameplay at 25-40 enemies across the required three-cycle prepare/advance/reset protocol, recording frame-time distributions, active/pooled counts, transient budgets, runtime errors, and cleanup deltas.
Host/Tester performs reset and retry from dense gameplay, confirming stable baseline counts, pause/input/run state, audio/effect ownership, and no duplicate terminal transitions.

Host/Tester exercises upgrade-draft keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus and selection, confirming silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new values, restrained copy, and omitted unchanged or placeholder rows.

Host/Tester performs ordinary movement/movement replay around the central building/landmark and along the boundary/perimeter, checking collision, external world depth, spawn/navigation exclusion, and absence of disappearance or occlusion drift, then reruns native_godot_project and host_godot_boot.
visual: Capture shipped-camera spawn, dense-wave, upgrade-draft, central-building approach/contact/departure, and perimeter views. Confirm authored cemetery composition remains intact, external depth continues beyond the playable boundary, the landmark stays visible and legible, dense combat remains readable, and choice cards maintain authored visual hierarchy with distinct focus states.

done_when: The dense-run path sustains 25-40 active enemies with target 32 without unbounded growth in enemies, projectiles, pickups, effects, lights, audio voices, or orphan nodes.

Enemy, projectile, pickup, vitality-bar, transient-effect, timer, and signal ownership is reclaimed on death, timeout, despawn, victory, failure, reset, and retry; reset/retry receipts show stable baseline counts and no stale callbacks or freed-instance access.

Dense per-frame work is bounded or staggered through deterministic buckets, cached registries, and activity/visibility gating while preserving targeting legality, telegraphs, hit causality, drops, upgrades, and boss transitions.

Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy: weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, never NEW or LOCKED as a placeholder in the CURRENT value column, no unchanged or exhaustive stat rows, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

The arena can expand to a larger traversable scale with a coherent external world and external depth beyond the gameplay boundary; the central building and landmark remain visible and legible with aligned collision, navigation/spawn exclusion, and bounded camera handling, with no disappearance or occlusion drift.

Tester can perform ordinary movement and movement replay before approach, at near contact, after departure, and along the full boundary and perimeter, confirming the player and representative enemies cannot pass through or become hidden inside the central building or landmark.
The intact authored cemetery remains the sole authoritative visual environment, and native_godot_project plus host_godot_boot preservation checks remain passing.

Tester can retest a sustained dense wave, upgrade draft, landmark traversal, and reset/retry in one session using runtime counts, frame-time/update-budget, cleanup, focus-state, and spatial receipts; instrumentation is supporting evidence, not completion by itself.
tasks.instructions: Inspect and repair the authoritative wave director, encounter spawner, enemy/projectile/pickup/effect lifecycles, run reset/retry paths, upgrade-draft presentation, and cemetery spatial contract. Implement strict live and spawn budgets plus pooling or bounded reclamation for high-churn entities; stagger neighbor, steering, vitality, presentation, light, optional-effect, and expensive query work using stable actor ownership; cancel deferred work and disconnect transient ownership during every lifecycle transition. Preserve authoritative combat, telegraphs, target legality, drops, upgrades, boss phases, and the intact authored map. Replace any text-stacked weapon or upgrade choices with authored visual hierarchy using silhouettes/icons first, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW or LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, no unchanged or exhaustive rows, restrained copy, and deterministic keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, and selected states. Ensure the spatial contract can expand to a larger traversable scale with coherent external world/external depth, and that the central building/landmark aligns with collision, navigation and spawn exclusion, boundary/perimeter traversal, ordinary movement/movement replay, and camera occlusion handling. Add only candidate-owned telemetry for active/pooled counts, frame-time distributions, cleanup receipts, draft/focus state, and spatial checkpoints; keep tester-only setup guarded from release exports.
